CP_NEWS_SUBTITLE: More ways to change the stakes. Mix these challenges in the game configuration.
CP_NEWS_SHELLS: Show only the shell count, or hide the entire charge. Keep track of what is left yourself.
CP_NEWS_ITEMS: Retractable covers hide the dealer’s inventory. Items reappear when used or when you choose one to steal.
CP_NEWS_SHUFFLE: Turn off shuffling to load shells in the order shown on the table. Remember the sequence to get ahead.
CP_NEWS_TURN: Keep the first move, alternate with the dealer after each reload, or leave it to chance.
CP_NEWS_HEALTH: Hide both health displays. Every hit and every heal becomes something to remember.
CP_NEWS_MIRROR: The dealer receives a copy of your inventory after distribution. Plan around the same tools on both sides.
CP_NEWS_POCKET: Limit how many items you can use in a turn. Save your best combination for the right moment.
CP_NEWS_CONTRACT_TITLE: A new clause at the table
CP_NEWS_CONTRACT: Twelve contracts change the rules. Two for the Price of One doubles damage and healing for both sides. Leaky Shotgun reverses your targets. Item restrictions only apply in rounds with items.
CP_NEWS_HEAL: Green shells restore 1 HP; shooting yourself keeps your turn. Invert one into a black shell for an instant kill. Black shells never spawn naturally.
CP_DETAIL_NO_HINTS: Do not use the magnifying glass or burner phone.
CP_DETAIL_UNTOUCHABLE_CHARGE: Do not use beer or an inverter.
CP_DETAIL_NO_INSURANCE:
Use either the magnifying glass or handcuffs per charge.
Repeating the same type is allowed.
CP_TWO_FOR_ONE: TWO FOR THE PRICE OF ONE
CP_DETAIL_TWO_FOR_ONE:
Both sides deal 2 damage or heal 2 HP.
A handsaw does not boost this again.
CP_DETAIL_LEAKY_GUN:
Your shots swap targets:
choose the dealer to shoot yourself, and vice versa.
CP_TIP_EDIT_CONTRACTS:

and their activation chance.

CP_MP_CONTRACT_FAILED: %s broke their contract and is out of this round.
CP_MP_NO_JAMMER_DETAIL: Do not use the jammer, including a stolen one.
CP_MP_INSURANCE_DETAIL: Use a magnifying glass or a jammer, never both in one charge.
CP_MP_DOUBLE_DETAIL: Your shots deal double damage and healing. A saw does not stack.
CP_MP_LEAKY_DETAIL: Aim at a rival to shoot yourself; aim at yourself to shoot a random living rival.
CP_MP_TIP_SHELLS: Show shell types, only their count, or hide the charge completely.

CP_MP_TIP_TURN: Choose who starts each charge. The normal turn direction still applies.
CP_MP_TIP_MIRROR: Replace living players’ inventories with matching sets at each distribution. Table limits still apply.
CP_MP_TIP_POCKET: Limit item uses per turn. Adrenaline and the stolen item count as one use.
CP_MP_TIP_CONTRACT: Each player can receive a personal contract until the next charge. Everyone can see it.
CP_MP_TIP_HEAL: One blank becomes a healing shell. Inversion swaps green healing and black instant-kill shells.
